items.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: Well he was thinking of I guess with the name Coon-Sander’s Nighthawks, and Don Redman, Fletcher Henderson, all the dance orchestras, Jean Goldkette, all of those.
